response.original_title: A Lap For Bill: Zach Miller's Hardrock 100
response.overview: After a ruptured appendix forced Zach to withdraw from the 2024 event at the eleventh hour, Zach returned in 2025 for his first attack on this iconic 100 mile loop in the San Juan Mountains of southwestern Colorado. For Zach, the race was more than a competitive objective for his illustrious race resume. It was a tribute to a friend and beloved member of the Hardrock family, the late Bill Dooper.  Though Zach's race wasn't perfect, he managed to finish back in Silverton, kissing the rock after admirably navigating many challenges along the brutal course. Carrying his friend along the trail in spirit, it became a lap for Bill.
